$comment: Catalog v9 — 14 items, prices globally unique. Each item ONCE PER DAY per player (UI-enforced; same-day repeats are audited); rebuying on later days is allowed and restocks single-use items. The barrel (45) is the personal save; the curfew bell (44) is a 50/50 village night off. No deadline: the game runs until the rope finds the bear or parity finds the village. Aimed items via p/aim; the barrel needs no aim — buying it is drinking it. The werebear may buy anything. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +25/day. docs/CATALOG.md is generated from this file.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: If today's vote ties on you, the nail steps you out of it. Whoever is left in the tie takes the rope — if more than one is left, nobody hangs. Single use.

items.label: Cold iron key
items.flavor: Fits more doors than it should.
items.effect: Pick a villager and a store. Tomorrow that store will not sell to them — they will find its door crossed out. Everyone is told which store was locked; only the victim sees it was for them. Nobody is told who bought the key.

items.label: Curfew bell
items.flavor: DING DONG. MURDER HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED.
items.effect: Ring it, and there is a 50/50 chance the werebear stays home tonight. Either way, the morning report says the bell rang.

general_store.label: General Store
general_store.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you can explain.

items.label: Pizza party
items.effect: If the village votes to banish you, the party saves you: nobody is banished today. The morning report names whose party it was. Each purchase saves you once.

items.label: Sock in mouth
items.flavor: Clean, mostly. That is not the point.
items.effect: Pick a villager. They can still type in the chat, but they lose their vote today. The morning report names them.

items.label: Barrel of beer
items.flavor: Finish it and the night finishes you.
items.effect: You cannot vote today, and you cannot be killed tonight — nothing gets through, including the tooth sharpener. No effect if you are the werebear.

items.label: Soup bone
items.flavor: Somebody else's dog will love you for it.
items.effect: Pick another villager. If the werebear targets you tonight, there is a 1 in 2 chance it targets them instead.

items.label: The butcher's knife
items.effect: Your vote counts twice at today's trial. Everyone is told a double vote was cast; nobody is ever told whose.

items.label: Tooth sharpener
items.flavor: Ask no questions about the previous owner.
items.effect: Werebear: your kill cannot be bargained away — offerings are taken along with their owner, and the morning report announces a sharpener was used. A soup bone can still deflect you to somebody else; only the barrel of beer stops the kill outright. Villager: if the werebear targets you tonight, a 50/50 chance it takes this instead and leaves you alone.

items.label: Gerald's finger
items.flavor: The Mayor swears it is his. The Mayor swears a lot.
items.effect: Does nothing. Gerald had eight — when the village has claimed them all, his thumbs come to market.

items.label: Gerald's thumb
items.effect: Does nothing. There are only two — and when both are claimed, the toes come to market.

items.label: Gerald's toe
items.flavor: This little piggy went to market.
items.effect: Does nothing. There are ten. After that, Gerald has no more to give.

items.label: Unquiet rest
items.flavor: The Mayor accepts coin for almost anything.
items.effect: When you die, a 50/50 chance your ghost can still vote. The result is announced either way.

items.label: The long candle
items.flavor: Burns all night. Sees about half of it.
items.effect: Pick a villager. A 50/50 chance you privately learn, on the spot, whether they are the werebear; otherwise you learn nothing. It never lies.
